item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text:
- **High — Repository-local Git configuration can trigger execution/network access.** `packages/workflow-control/src/sourceGit.ts`, `TrustedSourceGit.run`, disables system/global configuration but still loads repository-local configuration. In a partial clone, `cat-file` can lazily fetch missing objects using configured remotes and transport commands, including `core.sshCommand`. `captureCommittedReviewSkills` therefore does not guarantee local, inert reads before authentication. Disable lazy fetching and external transports for evidence capture, fail on missing objects, and add a regression fixture with a missing promised blob and a transport-command sentinel.

- **Medium — Required decision-behavior qualification is not evidenced.** `docs/planning/reviewer-skill-evidence.md` requires ten retained scenarios, manifests, outputs and individual assessments under RE5. None are supplied; the provided tests establish snapshot behavior and mount restrictions, not those review decisions. Supply the ten bound input/output records and assessments before marking RE5 complete.
